activity_summary: Alone, you said you would carry her opinion, and that you have been saying the rest of it to the plaster. You stopped. You did not say what the rest of it is.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke it once, to no one, and cut it off.

facets.activity: Said the rest of it to the plaster

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tell her mine opinion. I said I would.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have been saying the rest of it to the plaster.
